title: Things I have learned from the book
content:
1. You can't care about everything

Your time, energy, and attention are limited. If you try to care about everyone's opinions, every failure, every comparison, and every problem, you'll have nothing left for what actually matters.

Lesson: Choose your problems instead of trying to have no problems.

2. Don't try to be positive all the time

One of the book's strongest ideas is that negative experiences are unavoidable.

You will fail.
You will get rejected.
People will disappoint you.
You will make stupid decisions.

Trying to eliminate these experiences often makes them worse.

Instead: Accept that discomfort is part of life and learn to deal with it.
